IN PHOTOS │Members of All Workers Unity protest in Manila. From the corner of Quezon Blvd., they march until they reach Mendiola. They call for the enactment of a nationwide daily minimum wage of 1,200 pesos. They also criticize the government’s failure to immediately address the impact of the war in the Middle East. 

📸: Norman Cruz

both sides of the Lagos Ibadan Expressway are very free from Shagamu interchange to Iyana Oworo.

Different (4) trailers were noticed parked at different locations on the road, service lane between Ibafo Bus stop and Mountain Top University, MFM outwards Ogun State.

No vehicle was noticed parked on the long bridge.

Toll Gate (7up), Alapere, Ogudu, Car wash, and Iyana Oworo bus stops are very free at the moment.

Two trucks were noticed well parked on the road diverting to Ojota after 7up bus stop.

Sighting Ojota and ketu roads (to & fro) from Abiola Garden are free.
